title: Professional 2026-09-20 — Solar boiler storage and two heating circuits
goal: Show a boiler, thermal solar loop, buffer storage, fresh-water station and two independently pumped mixed heating circuits. Distinguish missing requested content from additional control functionality not requested.

rubric.must: Boiler, solar, fresh-water and both heating circuits can each be traced to their intended supply and return connections.
The storage temperature measurements and each motorized three-way mixing function are identifiable; a two-port valve with a three-way name alone is insufficient.
Process paths, instrument signal paths and long equipment labels remain distinguishable and readable.

provenance.notes: Selected against a real first user request. Source defects are intentionally preserved. Project identity is removed; no customer IDs or private prompt text are included.
